name: Loan Tape Report parameter view exposes As of Date and Generate Report button
description:
Objective: Loan Tape Report parameter view exposes As of Date and Generate Report button.
Preconditions: Open Reports comprehensive e2e with the configured test data.
Steps:
1. Open Reports comprehensive e2e.
2. Loan Tape Report parameter view exposes As of Date and Generate Report button.
3. Observe the resulting state.
Expected: Verify Loan Tape parameterized report form elements and last generated metadata.
